Democratic incumbent [[Herb Kohl]] was re-elected to a third term in a landslide over John Gillespie, despite Democratic nominee [[Al Gore]] winning the state only very narrowly in the [[2000 United States presidential election in Wisconsin|concurrent presidential election]]. == General election == === Candidates === * John Gillespie, founder of [[Rawhide Boys Ranch]]{{Cite web |url=http://nl.newsbank.com/nl-search/we/Archives?p_product=MWSB&p_theme=mwsb&p_action=search&p_maxdocs=200&p_topdoc=1&p_text_direct-0=0EB82DF752E18E16&p_field_direct-0=document_id&p_perpage=10&p_sort=YMD_date:D&s_trackval=GooglePM |title=Newsbank |access-date=2010-10-02 |archive-date=2012-10-23 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121023161543/http://nl.newsbank.com/nl-search/we/Archives?p_product=MWSB&p_theme=mwsb&p_action=search&p_maxdocs=200&p_topdoc=1&p_text_direct-0=0EB82DF752E18E16&p_field_direct-0=document_id&p_perpage=10&p_sort=YMD_date:D&s_trackval=GooglePM |url-status=dead }} (Republican) * Eugene A.
